summary: This tutorial explains how to create a feedback diagram using the software Xfig version 3.2 patch level 5. It starts with creating blocks, which were previously made in the block tutorial. You open the Xfig software, select a file, and enter the block name in the open entry box. After creating a figure named 'feedback', you add grids to the canvas by clicking on the grid icon. The mouse buttons have different functions depending on their position; for example, the left button moves the canvas up or down, while the right button moves it up or down. The middle button can drag the canvas to the center. To create a feedback diagram, copy a block, place it somewhere else, and add text using the text box. Adjust the text size and alignment to center it over the copied block. Then, use the polyline tool to draw lines with arrows, selecting the arrow mode and choosing the arrow type. This process allows you to build a feedback diagram step-by-step within Xfig.
